title: Sharp rank-three Chollet inequalities in order five: An exact rational certificate and complete equality classifications
description: An exact computer-assisted proof of the sharp real order-five rank-at-most-three self-Chollet inequality, with complete equality classification, together with the sharp two-matrix consequence and its equality cases. The deposit includes the paper, rational certificate, exact standard-library checker, mutation tests, discovery record, assurance statement and AI index. The proposed coefficient and witness are credited to Zeng, Liu and Ratnavelu; the contribution is the checked global proof and classifications.
notes: The rational certificate can be checked exactly, but the original generator, solver transcript and rational-repair trace are unavailable. The release is internally replayed and AI-reviewed; it is not externally peer reviewed or proof-assistant formalised.
